_meta.purpose: Names recalled from the published literature where the licensed evidence read (names.json: 67 PF texts via CDLI) holds none for a sex or origin (session 7, D-202; the user: "fill the gaps to the best of your educated ability"). _meta.tier: C: recalled, NOT SEEN; each attestation to be verified against the source (upgrade to A/B when read). Names are facts: nothing of any publication is bundled.
_meta.notable: royal women are kept out of the everyday pools (notable)
